reading.zh: 从左到右：先看观测契约与可用性判定（base），再看两种实现——真实 ArUco 推帧解算，与给仿真/HIL 用的注入式真值。共用的判据是"不可用就返回 None"。
reading.en: Left to right: the observation contract and usability rules first, then the two implementations - real ArUco frame solving and an injected ground-truth source for simulation/HIL. Shared rule: unusable means None.
